regime_context: US thematic state shows a narrow, defensive, crowded leadership cluster — the top four ranked themes are Big Pharma (eligible, durability 0.84, breadth 1.0, crowded), Health Care EW (eligible, crowded), Defensives (eligible, crowded, unscorable proxy list), and Consumer Staples EW (eligible, crowded) — while the nominal rank leader Memory/HBM is ineligible with a durability bar of only 0.35. Rotation breadth is narrowing (0.39 eligible) and absorption is low (0.32), indicating a fragile, non-directional tape. The validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, which is helping here; direction accuracy on past calls is a modest 41.3%, so conviction should stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch Big Pharma vs Health Care EW for a possible expansion of healthcare leadership into managed care/insurers (durability 0.76, not crowded). If managed care/insurers posts an eligible trend-tag week with breadth above 0.5, it would signal a broadening defensive-healthcare regime beyond the two crowded leaders.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only top-ranked theme that combines trend-gate eligibility with the strongest durability bar (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and a confirming val_state. This is the legitimate trend-discipline read: eligible, durable, broad. Crowding (z=1.46) cautions against sizing up, not direction.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.46 and the fact that Pharma leadership is itself a defensive reflex — if the macro rotation is a late-cycle bid for safety, a single positive risk-on catalyst could unwind the entire defensive cluster quickly.

falsifier.text: PPH ends a rolling 15-day stretch below its 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples EW is trend-gate eligible with a high durability bar (0.80) and strong breadth (0.879). It is the cleanest scorable defensive expression among the crowded top ranks, consistent with the market's defensive rotation. Crowding (z=1.89) is the highest caution in the cohort, implying reduced capacity.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z=1.89) is the strongest in the entire eligible set — any marginal derisking by trend followers could hit staples hardest on a reversal day, and XLP proxies the same trade as the unscored Defensives theme below it.

falsifier.text: XLP lags SPY by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the only top-10 eligible theme that is NOT crowded (z=0.31) and carries a trend tag, offering a growth-lean tilt against the heavily crowded defensive cluster. It is a judgment call that the defensive crowding leaves non-crowded energy as the better trend-carry candidate.
theses.dissent: Durability bar of 0.48 is well below the defensive leaders (0.78-0.84), and breadth is 0.0 — this is a narrow, nearly single-name energy complex with weak cohesion, vulnerable to a single demand-data surprise.

falsifier.text: XLE has a daily close below its 200-day moving average before the check-by date
